look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Inspect the small five-petaled white flowers with numerous stamens and pointed green sepals, then check divided basal leaves and later the bristly round fruit cluster of hooked styles.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Erect branching perennial forb, often in woodland shade or disturbed edges.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Basal leaves pinnately divided, with larger terminal segment; alternate stem leaves become less divided upwards and have toothed margins.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Small five-petaled white flowers, green pointed sepals between petals, numerous stamens.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Globose head of achenes with persistent hooked styles; this mature feature is diagnostic and needs macro photography.

key_traits.label: Stem bud
key_traits.text: Hairy to sparsely hairy branching stems; check stipules and petioles.
